rules.felt: (a) any mesh-slot footprint (true XZ convex hull of the FBX vertices, instance frame + per-axis scale) overlaps the plan polygon (XZ projection of the OBB) of any GolfSurface part (205: Felt, CupPlate, H7 island stone collider, mover decks at edit pose); touching counts
rules.rail: (b) min plan distance between any mesh-slot footprint and any Geometry.Wall part (322) < 1.0 stud
rules.float: (c) contact ring = the stem lowest vertices (within 0.05 of the lowest point, up to 16 spread points); ground = Terrain + every visible non-dressing BasePart (visual tiles query-enabled for the check, restored); ray from lowest+5 down 200 per ring point; floats when every ring point is > 0.1 above its ground hit (or no hit)

tool: tools/sc9_plan.py (a, b, offline from inventory-before.json + FBX hulls), tools/sc9_place.py float (c, in Studio)
